captured: spelling game - a word appears and you type it

preset_rejected.why: answer quadrants are for games where you stand on your answer, and here the answer is typed - there is nothing for the tiles to represent

skill_gap.name: quiz genre ambiguity
skill_gap.why: Puzzle offers a Word / Quiz preset and simultaneously tells you to send physical-element-free quizzes to Party & Casual, so two rules point at two files for the same prompt; following the boundary note then lands on a Quiz preset whose answer-tile floor is wrong for a typed answer, which means neither route produces a clean result
